title: Complex Care - Haematology at The Harborne Hospital
file: Complex Care - Haematology at The Harborne Hospital.mp4

shots.description: Low, slow forward move through an empty treatment area at The Harborne Hospital, passing curved wood-panelled bay dividers, ceiling-mounted service columns and armchairs toward a door at the end of the corridor.

Low-angle moving shot through an empty haematology day unit at The Harborne Hospital, passing wood-panelled treatment bays with recliner chairs, a patient monitor and weighing scales, and a nurses' station counter, towards a corridor with doors.

Camera swings from a blurred office area with computer desks to an empty ward corridor at The Harborne Hospital, showing a nurses' station, a standing weighing scale and wood-panelled walls. The opening is motion-blurred; the second half settles into a steady view down the corridor.

Low-angle moving shot through an empty treatment area at The Harborne Hospital, passing wood-panelled bay partitions with privacy curtains, an armchair, handwash sinks and a corridor leading to a door at the far end.

Camera tracks right from an empty treatment room with an infusion chair, past a wall, to reveal an empty patient room with a made hospital bed, bedside monitors and infusion pumps at The Harborne Hospital.

Looking through a partly open door into an empty patient room with a made hospital bed, an overbed table, a bedside monitor and a stand of infusion pumps. The camera moves sideways past the door frame, which briefly fills the screen, then reveals the bed and equipment from a new angle.

View through a gap in a doorway into an empty patient room at The Harborne Hospital, showing a made bed, a Philips patient monitor and infusion pumps on a stand by the window. The camera tracks sideways past an out-of-focus wall in the foreground, which briefly fills the frame before revealing the room again.

Camera moves past a doorway to reveal an empty, prepared patient room with a made bed, overbed table, and bedside monitors and pump stack, filmed for the haematology complex care service at The Harborne Hospital.
An empty patient room with a made hospital bed, patient monitors and infusion pumps. The camera moves across to an IV drip stand holding fluid bags in front of a frosted window.

An IV drip stand holding an infusion bag and a bottle of fluid with tubing, set against a window with blurred trees outside. A quiet cutaway suggesting infusion treatment in a haematology setting at The Harborne Hospital.

IV drip stand holding infusion bags and tubing in front of a window with soft daylight and blurred trees outside. The camera moves right and the drip stand goes out of focus, ending on the edge of a chair.

Close-up of a patient's hand with a taped IV cannula and infusion line, resting on the armrest of an infusion chair during haematology treatment at The Harborne Hospital. The patient sits still by a window, and the focus shifts slightly during the shot.

An IV drip stand with infusion bags and tubing stands in front of a frosted window, with trees and buildings blurred outside and the edge of a chair in view. The drip is set up beside a treatment chair, with no people in shot.

Close-up of a seated patient in an infusion chair with an IV cannula taped to the back of her hand, resting her arm on the armrest during haematology treatment. Her face is not shown, and the camera moves in past a blurred foreground edge.

Close-up of a patient's hand with a taped cannula and IV line, resting on the armrest of an infusion chair during treatment at The Harborne Hospital. The patient sits still while the camera drifts slowly across.

A woman sits in an infusion chair in a private treatment room at The Harborne Hospital, with a cannula in her arm and an IV drip stand beside her. The camera moves past a privacy curtain toward her as she rests with her arms on the chair.

A female patient sits in an infusion chair with a cannula in her hand, receiving treatment in a haematology day unit at The Harborne Hospital. The camera tracks sideways past a curtain to reveal her next to an IV stand with infusion pumps.

A female patient with a dressing on her arm sits in a reclining infusion chair beside an IV drip stand in a private treatment room at The Harborne Hospital. The camera pulls back past a curtain to reveal the room, an over-bed table across her lap and a visitor chair.

A female patient in a yellow top sits in an infusion chair with an over-chair table in a haematology day treatment room at The Harborne Hospital. The camera moves slowly past a wooden partition and privacy curtain toward her.

A patient sits back in an infusion chair in a treatment bay with an overbed table in front of her, IV drip stands beside her and a frosted window with a plant pattern behind. The camera moves sideways past wooden partition panels, revealing the bay.
Close-up of an IV drip stand holding two infusion bags in front of a window with blurred trees outside. Fluid lines run down from the bags; no people are in shot.

Close-up of an IV drip stand holding an infusion bag and a bottle of fluid with lines running down, in front of a window with blurred trees outside. A quiet cutaway suggesting treatment in a patient room.

A patient receives an IV infusion while seated in an infusion chair at The Harborne Hospital. The shot moves from the drip bag and infusion pumps on the stand to her cannulated hand resting on the chair arm.

A patient in a yellow top sits in an infusion chair with a cannula taped to the back of her hand. The camera moves across from her hand to an IV drip stand with infusion pumps during a haematology treatment session. Her face is not shown.

IV drip bags and infusion pumps on stands beside a frosted window in a day treatment area, with the shot moving across to patients in infusion chairs, one with a cannula in her hand. Haematology day-case infusion at The Harborne Hospital.

Close-up of a patient's hand with an IV cannula and clear dressing resting on the armrest of an infusion chair during a haematology treatment session at The Harborne Hospital. The infusion line runs down from the hand. The patient's face is not shown.

Close-up of a patient's hand with a taped IV cannula resting on the arm of an infusion chair. The camera pulls back to show her seated in the chair receiving an infusion from a drip stand and pump beside a window.
A woman sits in an infusion chair with a cannula in her hand while receiving treatment from an IV drip and infusion pump, filmed through gaps in privacy curtains as the camera tracks past.

A patient sits in an infusion chair receiving an infusion through a cannula in her hand, with an infusion pump on a drip stand beside her, at The Harborne Hospital. The camera moves past a privacy curtain to reveal her looking out across the treatment area.

A woman in a yellow top sits in a reclining infusion chair with an over-chair table, a line in her arm, in a private haematology treatment room at The Harborne Hospital. The shot is framed through a doorway past a curtain and wooden wardrobe, with a grey visitor armchair in the foreground.

A woman sits in a reclining infusion chair in a private treatment room at The Harborne Hospital, with an IV pole and infusion pump beside her and an over-chair table in front. The camera moves sideways past a curtain to reveal her looking towards the camera.

A woman sits in an infusion chair in a haematology treatment bay. The camera moves past a film crew member and lighting stand to a nurses' station where two staff members stand talking. The behind-the-scenes crew and kit are visible mid-shot.

Two nurses walk side by side along a ward corridor past the nurses' station at The Harborne Hospital, talking as one holds a sheet of paper. The camera tracks backwards ahead of them as they approach.
A nurse and a colleague walk into a curtained bay on a haematology day unit and talk with a female patient seated in an infusion chair beside an IV drip stand.

A patient sits in an infusion chair beside an IV drip stand and infusion pumps while a nurse and a colleague talk with her in a day treatment room at The Harborne Hospital. The camera moves in from a wide view of the group to a medium shot of the patient.

A patient sits in an infusion chair by a large frosted window in a haematology treatment room, chatting with a nurse and a staff member in a blue top who stand on either side of her. IV drip stands and an over-chair table are beside her.

A seated woman in an infusion chair, next to a drip stand and infusion pumps, talks with a grey-haired man in glasses. The camera moves past him to end on her face as she listens and smiles, in a treatment room at The Harborne Hospital with frosted windows and trees outside.

A female patient sits in an infusion chair and smiles as she talks with a grey-haired staff member in glasses, shot over his shoulder, in a haematology treatment room at The Harborne Hospital. An infusion pump on an IV pole sits beside her in front of a frosted window.

A patient sits in an infusion chair beside an IV pole with infusion pumps, smiling and talking with a staff member seen over the shoulder in the foreground, during haematology treatment at The Harborne Hospital.

Over-the-shoulder shot of a nurse talking with a smiling female patient seated in an infusion chair, with an IV drip stand and infusion pumps beside her, in the haematology day unit at The Harborne Hospital.

A woman sits in an infusion chair beside an IV pole with infusion pumps, smiling and talking with a staff member seen from behind in the foreground. This is an over-the-shoulder conversation in a haematology treatment area.

Push-in shot through an empty critical care room at The Harborne Hospital, showing ceiling-mounted equipment pendants, infusion pumps, Philips patient monitors and a made-up hospital bed beside a window.

An empty critical care bay at The Harborne Hospital with a made hospital bed, over-bed table, ceiling-mounted equipment pendants, infusion pumps and a Philips patient monitor. The camera pulls back slowly to show the whole bay.
